label: Undergraduate RA
heading: Undergraduate research
intro: We welcome undergraduates who are curious about research. Roles depend on active projects, mentoring capacity, and funding, so we can't guarantee an opening, but we're happy to hear from you.
steps: Explore our current work and find an area that interests you.
Share any research, design, programming, or social-science experience you have.
Let us know roughly when and how much time you could contribute.
